title: 第13章 血火佣兵团的追杀第14章 唐沐
slug: 无限吞噬你们求我晋级慢一点
content_zh:
“找死。”
江尘怒了。
“焚焰掌。”
江尘一掌拍出，瞬间就将一个要杀过来的佣兵给拍飞。
“啊……”
那名佣兵惨叫一声，直接被拍飞，在倒飞的过程中不停地吐血。
对方都要杀他了，江尘当然不会留手了，一记焚焰掌直接重创一名佣兵。
这名佣兵狠狠地摔在地上，瞬间就失去了战斗力，被重创了。
“这个小子这么厉害？”
其他几人也是一惊。
“不管了，一起上，杀了他。”
于是其他四名佣兵纷纷向江尘出手。
谁知道江尘手中的长刀，快速地挥斩，一下子就将眼前的四人给斩杀了。
刀法十分霸道凌厉。
“这是什么刀法？”
队长看到江尘的实力之后，十分震惊。
江尘虽然是武者境四重，但是刚才的战力却是如此强大，让他这个武者境八重的高手也感到有压力。
短短几招之内，就斩杀了四个对手。
刚才江尘使用的刀法正是火老传授给他的霸刀诀。
“大胆，你居然敢杀我们血火佣兵团的人，那么谁也救不了你。”

大汉队长怒喝道。
“笑话，你们都要杀我了，还不让我反击不成？你们技不如人，死了也是活该，那么，接下来就轮到你了。”
江尘冷笑道。
然后向着佣兵队长杀了过来。
佣兵队长面色一变，同样一刀斩出，向冲过来的江尘斩去。
“铮……”
两把长刀撞在一起，一道身影被震退。
被震退的人正是那个佣兵队长。
此时的他一脸的惊骇，刚才二人的长刀一接触，他就从江尘的长刀那儿感受强大力量，直接将他震退了。
“不可能，你一个武者境四重怎么可能有这么强大的力量？居然能震退我武者境八重。”
佣兵队长惊呼。
“没有什么不可能的，所以，你还是去死吧。”
江尘冷哼一声，接着杀了过来。
content_en:
"Seeking death."
Jiang Chen was angry.
"Burning Flame Palm."
Jiang Chen slapped out a palm and instantly knocked away a mercenary who was about to kill him.
"Ah..."
The mercenary screamed and was knocked away, vomiting blood as he flew backwards.
The other party was about to kill him, so of course Jiang Chen would not hold back. He directly hit a mercenary with a burning palm.
The mercenary fell hard to the ground, instantly lost his combat effectiveness and was severely injured.
"Is this kid so powerful?"
Several other people were also surprised.
"No matter what, let's go together and kill him."
So the other four mercenaries attacked Jiang Chen one after another.
Who knew that the long knife in Jiang Chen's hand would be swung quickly, killing the four people in front of him in one fell swoop.
His sword skills are very domineering and sharp.
"What kind of sword technique is this?"
The captain was shocked when he saw Jiang Chen's strength.
Although Jiang Chen is at the fourth level of the warrior realm, his combat power just now was so powerful that even a master at the eighth level of the warrior realm felt pressured.
In just a few moves, four opponents were killed.
The sword technique Jiang Chen used just now was the Sword Overlord Technique taught to him by Mr. Huo.
"Bold, you actually dare to kill members of our Blood Fire Mercenary Group, then no one can save you."
The burly captain shouted angrily.
"What a joke, you are going to kill me, why don't you let me fight back? You are not as skilled as others, so you deserve to die. Then, it will be your turn next."
Jiang Chen sneered.
Then he came towards the mercenary captain and killed him.
The mercenary captain's expression changed, and he also slashed out with his sword, slashing at Jiang Chen who was charging towards him.
"Zheng..."
Two long knives collided together, and a figure was knocked back.
The person who was knocked back was the mercenary captain.
At this time, he had a look of horror on his face. As soon as the two people's swords came into contact, he felt the powerful force from Jiang Chen's sword and directly knocked him back.
"Impossible, how can you, a fourth-level warrior, be so powerful? You can actually repel me, an eighth-level warrior."
The mercenary captain exclaimed.
"Nothing is impossible, so you might as well die."
Jiang Chen snorted coldly, then came over to kill him.
